The Creative Process 🎨 | Pokémon TCG/Santa Cruz BTS | Episode 2
Join us behind the scenes in the making of our newest collaboration with @SantaCruzSkateboards as we explore the creative process of representing each of the selected 30 Pokémon TCG cards with unique board art. From chatting with original artists, to highlighting easter eggs, see what it took to bring these original designs to life! 

Catch the full story coming to YouTube October 15th and get ready for the collaboration drop on October 17th at 6am PT.
